checks.check: decisions are persisted and the trace chain is intact
checks.detail: 18 persisted records, links intact; the runtime's own summary agrees

checks.check: no look-ahead: every decision consumed only sealed bars
checks.detail: every one of 18 traces has window_end_ts <= decision_time_ms (window_end is the newest bar's open, so the sealed bar closes before the decision)

checks.check: the freshness gate is enforced: a late context cannot reach a proposal
checks.detail: max age 537.7 s against a 450 s budget (1.5 bars of 5m); 6 of 18 evaluations were late, 6 of them were rejected by the router for exactly that reason, and 0 produced a proposal

checks.check: the strategy router ran and never selected a candidate that emitted no alpha
the risk engine reviewed every proposal (deterministic, binding on orders)
checks.detail: no evaluation carried a proposal, so the binding path was never entered: 18 rows are NO_TRADE with risk ['NOT_APPLICABLE']; the runtime reviews risk only when there is something to review (§3 of the runtime document)

checks.check: the independent verifier graded the decisions it was asked to grade
checks.detail: verifier verdicts ['NOT_RUN']: a NO_TRADE row with no proposal is not sent to the verifier, so this branch is NOT_EXERCISED in a window whose router rejects everything

checks.check: the agents were reachable from the live path
checks.detail: 0 agent message(s) recorded; with no proposal the registry is never consulted, so the live window cannot prove the agents are reachable and says so

checks.check: checkpoint and resume: a later run continues the same chain
checks.detail: paper_state.json exists=True; leg 2-bar-close-cadence continued from record 6 and added 2; leg 3-controlled-stop continued from record 8 and added 4; leg 4-resume-after-stop continued from record 12 and added 6

checks.check: every evaluation is accounted for and no order was created
checks.detail: 18 evaluations across 4 leg(s), 0 runtime failure(s), 0 order(s), 0 production action(s)

checks.check: the window reached the 24 h the operator asked for
checks.detail: 0.0621 h executed of 24.0 h (0.259% of the target): the rehearsal is prepared and driven, the window is not complete, so no stability verdict is issued

stages.stage: decision persisted to the trace chain

flow_coverage.why_the_rest_was_not_reached: a decision may only create an order when a strategy is admitted and its net edge is positive; no strategy in the ledger is admitted, and every proposal was classified NO_GROSS_EDGE, so the order-creating stages are unreachable in a real window by design rather than by defect

stability_reason: a window shorter than the target cannot pass a stability test, and the checks the short window could not reach are reported as NOT_EXERCISED rather than PASS

budgets.disk: measured per leg, by summing the run root before and after
budgets.process_tree: the figures aggregate the child and every descendant: a virtual environment's python.exe can be a launcher stub, and sampling it alone would report the stub's few megabytes instead of the runtime's
budgets.note: resource figures cover the paper child tree only, not the whole lab

not_claimed: any branch of the flow the executed window never entered
